description.value: Yuko Maki is a sushi restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue, one of North Vancouver's main commercial corridors and a natural route for cyclists arriving from the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal. The OSM record notes both indoor and outdoor seating, suggesting a sit-down dining experience suited for a mid-ride or post-ride meal. Its location on a busy arterial makes it easy to spot and access by bike.
